def purge_note_and_clear_backlinks(db, note_id):
    # Archive the note row before deletion
    db.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS deleted_notes AS SELECT * FROM notes WHERE 0')
    db.execute('INSERT INTO deleted_notes SELECT * FROM notes WHERE id = ?', (note_id,))
    token = f'[[{note_id}]]'
    linked = db.execute('SELECT id, body FROM notes WHERE body LIKE ?', (f'%{token}%',)).fetchall()
    for other_id, body in linked:
        db.execute('UPDATE notes SET body = ? WHERE id = ?', (body.replace(token, ''), other_id))
    db.execute('DELETE FROM notes WHERE id = ?', (note_id,))
    db.commit()
    return len(linked)
